name: Benjamin
summary: Rachel's second son, born as she died on the road to Ephrath: she named him Ben-oni, son of my sorrow, and Jacob called him Benjamin. Jacob kept him at home when his brothers went to Egypt; Joseph demanded he be brought, gave him five times as much as the others, and had his silver cup hidden in Benjamin's sack to test the brothers.
body: After Joseph is lost, Benjamin is the son Jacob will not risk: “My son will not go down there with you.” Only the famine and Judah's pledge change his mind.

Joseph, seeing his mother's son, has to leave the room to weep. The cup is found in Benjamin's sack; the brothers return with him, Judah offers himself as a slave in his place, and Joseph, unable to restrain himself, tells them who he is. Jacob's blessing calls him a ravenous wolf; Paul names himself of Benjamin's tribe.
